integrity: Statements and calculations self-contained in RESULT.md and check_crossing_envelope.py. Published free-crossing and Poisson results are acknowledged, not presented as new.
scientific_limitations: All-clock optimality assumes independent iid positive finite-mean complete renewal resets of both position and velocity, an undamped random-acceleration process, and a nonzero counted level. Reset discontinuities are excluded. Low-mean supremum needs arbitrarily short ideal zero-cost reset intervals. The decimals are not certified enclosures. Independent scientific validation and exhaustive publication priority are not claimed.
title: A sharp fixed-mean renewal-clock transition for random-acceleration level crossings
